build_config: build-config/agent-release.gn (committed to the fork — survives upstream syncs)
args_gn: is_debug=false is_component_build=false dcheck_always_on=false symbol_level=0 blink_symbol_level=0 is_official_build=false enable_nacl=false target_cpu="x64" proprietary_codecs=true ffmpeg_branding="Chrome"

codecs.note: USE_PROPRIETARY_CODECS=1 (media_buildflags.h) AND proven at runtime: canPlayType returns 'probably' for H.264, AAC, MP3 on the shipped binary.

capabilities_note: fork.2 agent layer. The VERSION handshake and cookie export/import are newer engine work not in this binary; they ship in a later release.

gates.codecs_runtime: pass — canPlayType 'probably' for H.264/AAC/MP3 on the shipped binary

macos.args_gn: is_debug=false is_component_build=false dcheck_always_on=false symbol_level=0 blink_symbol_level=0 is_official_build=false proprietary_codecs=true ffmpeg_branding="Chrome"

gates.codesign: pass — codesign --verify --deep --strict on the unpacked tarball
gates.gatekeeper: pass — spctl: accepted, source=Notarized Developer ID
gates.relocation: pass — launcher links @executable_path/../Frameworks, runs from an unpacked copy
gates.spool_protocol: pass — launched via chromium-agent-launch.cjs from the unpacked tarball, eval over the spool
gates.codecs_runtime: pass — canPlayType 'probably' for H.264/AAC/MP3/VP9 on the shipped app

macos.install: unpacks to $CHROME_AGENT_ENGINE_DIR/Chromium.app; the launcher finds it via CHROMIUM_SENDKEYS_OUT
